exposure: International Association of Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Group (IADPSG) criteria
outcome: prevalence of gestational glucose metabolism abnormalities
finding: Treatment of women with GDM identified by the IADPSG criteria was associated with a significantly lower risk of multiple adverse pregnancy outcomes compared to the NDDG criteria, supporting the use of IADPSG criteria in China.
mod_finding: The prevalence of cesarean section was significantly lower when IADPSG criteria were applied for GDM diagnosis.
